description: Run a Neural Filter (Filter > Neural Filters) on the active layer without its workspace: Depth Blur, Style Transfer or Photo Restoration. The filter must already be downloaded in the Neural Filters panel; some filters process in the cloud and need a signed-in Adobe account

options.description: Sliders, 0-100. depth_blur: aperture, focalDistance, focalRange, haze. style_transfer: brushSize, preserveWeight, blur. photo_restoration: enhance (Photo Enhancement), faceEnhance (Enhance Face), scratches (Scratch Reduction), luminanceNoise, colorNoise, halftoning (Halftone Artifacts Reduction), removeJpeg (JPEG Artifacts Reduction)

preserveColor.description: style_transfer: keep the image's colours. Default false

name: apply_neural_filter
title: Apply Neural Filter
